Question: Let \(T_1\) be a triangle with sides \(2011,\) \(2012,\) and \(2013.\) For \(n\ge1,\) if \(T_n=\triangle ABC\) and \(D,\) \(E,\) and \(F\) are the points of tangency of the incircle of \(\triangle ABC\) to the sides \(AB,\) \(BC,\) and \(AC,\) respectively, then \(T_{n+1}\) is a triangle with side lengths \(AD,\) \(BE,\) and \(CF,\) if it exists. What is the perimeter of the last triangle in the sequence \((T_n)?\)
